meta.name: paid-ads-tiktok
meta.description: Plan and review TikTok Ads creative experiments with measurement, rights, and conversion guardrails. Use for TikTok advertising, Spark Ads, short-form video ads, creator briefs, TikTok campaign setup, or TikTok performance exports.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 规划并审查 TikTok 广告创意实验,带好衡量与合规护栏
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果在 TikTok 上做广告投放并需要规划创意实验
copy.tagline_en: Plan and review TikTok ad creative experiments with measurement and compliance guardrails
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you run TikTok ads and need to plan creative experiments

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会基于已验证资料规划与审查 TikTok 广告创意实验：先明确转化事件、负责方与优惠，再设计可测试的前几秒钩子和创意变量，并核查素材权利与声明，最后给你一份可执行的启动简报。
howto.when: 当你涉及 TikTok 广告、Spark Ads、短视频广告或创作者简报等需求时触发。

say.text: 帮我规划一个 TikTok 广告实验，目标提高应用安装量。
say.note: Claude 会先确认转化事件与测量方案。

say.text: 审查这个 Spark Ads 创意，重点检查素材授权与报价声明。
say.note: 它会核对权利和声明，无法确认的标记待验证。

say.text: 根据这份 TikTok 导出数据，给出下一步创意测试建议。
say.note: 会结合现有表现规划新测试。

howto.what_en: Claude will plan and review TikTok ad creative experiments using verified sources only: define conversion events, measurement owner, and offer, then design testable hooks and creative variables, verify rights and claims, and deliver a launch brief for the operator.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you need to plan or review TikTok ads, Spark Ads, short-form video ads, or creator briefs.

say_en.text: Help me plan a TikTok ad experiment to boost app installs.
say_en.note: Claude will confirm conversion event and measurement plan.

say_en.text: Review this Spark Ads creative, especially licensing and price claims.
say_en.note: It checks rights and claims, flagging unverified ones.

say_en.text: Based on this TikTok export, suggest next creative tests.
say_en.note: It will use current performance to plan new tests.
